thread:
lauren: Heads up — we're rolling a new price sheet experiment next month and need to map all downstream dependencies before we lock the cutover date. Primary ask: who owns the CSV->billing mapping and the vendor passthroughs?

mike: I own the CSV ingestion job (acct-sync). Will need the column spec and any new rate ids.

lauren: Great. Preliminary plan: two arms (A = current rates, B = tiered price_v2). Canary at 5% of active customers for 7 days. Grandfather window: 60 days for existing subscriptions, but we might need special handling for reserved capacity contracts.

ashish: Reserved customers are on a separate ledger, will need to toggle a grandfather flag. Also vendor contract 1234 has a minimum commitment clause — need legal signoff for any retro adjustments.

sophie: I'll review the vendor contract and confirm if the minimum commitment forces us to carve out certain accounts from the A/B. If so, we should add a pre-filter step in the rollout pipeline.

natalie: Payments team: reminder that any price changes that affect invoices > $1k require AR notification. How will we signal manual invoice reviews?

lauren: Plan is to surface a "requires-manual-review" tag in the ingest when delta > 20% or invoice amount > $1k. Mike — can acct-sync add that tag? Also we need a CSV sample for the billing-runner.

mike: Yep. I can add a tag. Sample CSV snippet:

```
account_id,rate_id,quantity,price_override,manual_review_flag
12345,price_v2_tier1,100, ,false
67890,price_v2_tier2,50, ,true
```

lauren: Good. Metrics gating: failed invoices < 0.1% and retro credits < $5k for the canary to proceed. If either threshold breaches, rollback. Sound reasonable?

ashish: Agree. Also add metering-window checks — some customers report delayed usage; we should exclude accounts with known delayed ingestion from canary. I'll provide a list.

sophie: Legal needs to approve the communication language for customers who are grandfathered or receiving a retro credit. Draft it and tag me.

natalie: For AR workflow, we'll create a shared spreadsheet for manual review items and assign owners. Suggest prefix: "AR-PRICING-REVIEW-<date>".

billing-bot: deploy-checklist: tests: csv-schema, manual-review-flag, api-contracts, invoice-sim. All tests must pass in staging.

lauren: Timeline proposal: final price sheet by EOD next Tue (2167960000), staging tests by Fri, canary start Tue following (2168564800). Approvals required: Sophie (legal), Revenue Ops signoff (Ashish), and Finance Exec (+Natalie for AR).

mike: I'll open a checkout PR with the CSV schema and a staging job. Will include a quick sanity script to simulate invoice deltas.

ashish: I'll prepare the cohort selection query for the 5% randomization and the exclude-list for reserved/minimum-commitment accounts.

lauren: Thanks. Action items: Mike — CSV schema PR, Natalie — AR spreadsheet template, Ashish — cohort & exclude list, Sophie — legal language by next Tue. I'll consolidate and send to execs for signoff once we have all pieces. :thumbsup:

sophie: Sounds good. Please cc legal on the final doc. :white_check_mark:

natalie: I'll seed the AR sheet and invite owners.

mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/billing/compare/price-sheet-schema. Running staging tests now.

lauren: Perfect — keep updates in this thread. If any vendor constraints surface, flag immediately so we can decide carve-outs before canary. :eyes:
